title: Rules from the TRaSH Guides
text: The rules in your profiles come from the TRaSH Guides. They are published under the MIT licence.
adoptHint: Your profiles keep their rules until you save them again. Until then they show as outdated.
adopted: New state adopted. Save your profiles again to use it for them.
breaks: The new state does not work with the profiles of {{versions}}. nexcrate stays with the current state.
breaksPlain: The new state does not work with one of your profiles. nexcrate stays with the current state.
unreachable: GitHub cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
daily: Check for a new state every day
dailyHint: nexcrate asks GitHub once a day. Nothing is adopted unless you say so.
